notes.title: Special Bundle Offer for LIMITED TIME!
notes.content:
Hello, jigsaw and art enthusiasts!

For the first time since the release of Pieces of Beauty 3 we have the opportunity to put all three Pieces of Beauty games on sale at the same time. This will happen through the Weeklong Deal for September 12, but we got an idea to go even further with our intent to provide the best deal possible for our audience.


Along with the highest discount of 50% off on each game during the week, we created the  Special Jigsaw Bundle - Pieces of Beauty.

This bundle will apply a 50% discount on the already discounted games.


Yes, we are going all in with this offer and this is our best way to say THANK YOU to all of you guys who played, commented, posted your experiences and screenshots on the Community Hub and Reviews Section.

We could go on and publish PoB 2 and 3 only because of your feedback, feeling that every new music or piece of art and all the gameplay tweeks were there due to the players involvement on the launch of every installment of the PoB series.

The bundle will be available only during this special week, and depending on your country, it may not be visible. We tried our best to bring it to most of our audience, but Steam has its restrictions. If you can't see the bundle, we hope the Weeklong Deals of 50% off alone can make the games inexpensive to you.

Hope to see you soon!

notes.title: Pieces of Beauty 2 Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello, jigsaw and art enthusiasts!

We are happy to announce the launch of Pieces of Beauty 2!
Thanks to your support, we were able to develop a new game that refines everything we have originally envisioned while keeping the essence of the first Pieces of Beauty.

Taking note of all the feedback you players sent to us, we are delivering this game that contains:

- Improved user interface
- New excellent background music added to enrich your gameplay experience
- A total of 13 jigsaw puzzles made from 16 new amazing prints from Ohara Koson

 Buy Pieces of Beauty 2

We truly hope you apreciate this new game.
Don't forget to buy it during this week to save 40% with the special promotion we are offering during the launch!

Hope to see you soon!

notes.title: Update Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello, jigsaw and art enthusiasts!
We are providing an update to fix some bugs and change minor details in the game.

Changes:
- Audio Bug fixed
- Help Button repositioned in the game room

We also started some discussions on our page to make easier for ou players to reach out to us.
You can report bugs and glitches here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1749380/discussions/0/2959418921928291214/

You can suggest new ideas and help us on delivering greater experiences for our next games here:

Hope to see you soon!
